review_notes: I read the whole file. The closest overlap is `ShortComplex.abelianImageToKernel : Abelian.image S.f ⟶ kernel S.g`. Mathlib's `imageToKernel'` (Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/ImageToKernel.lean) is built the same way, as `kernel.lift g (image.ι f)`, but it is a morphism `image f ⟶ kernel g`. The two use different models of the image. `Abelian.image f` is defined as `kernel (cokernel.π f)`. `Limits.image f` is the generic image, and `Abelian.imageIsoImage` relates the two only by an isomorphism. The file needs the `Abelian.image` model: `abelianImageToKernelIsKernel` and `LeftHomologyData.ofAbelian` rely on it being a kernel of `kernel.ι S.g ≫ cokernel.π S.f`, and the file's own documentation says so. `cokernelToAbelianCoimage` has no Mathlib counterpart, and I found no uses of either name outside this file. Replacing them would force extra isomorphisms into the proofs and gain little. The remaining declarations are the homology-data constructors, the Abelian instance on `ShortComplex C`, `homologyIsoImageICyclesCompPOpcycles` and `ofEpiMonoFactorisation`. These are canonical constructions for this setting. I found no independent Mathlib, Batteries or core duplicate of them, and I did not read the Batteries or core sources. The remaining uncertainty is whether `abelianImageToKernel` should be defined through `imageToKernel'`. I judged that case too weak to report.
